items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: And that's where I met such fellows like Jack the Bear, playin' the piano.

ctx.x: So, they would, well this little Josephine, this lady, won the cake. She was a little older than I was. She won the cake, and she was just comin' up, just goin' up the steps in this ball, when it was the Greenwaiters' Ball, One of those musical fun halls. (unintelligible) And she almost dropped this cake. And I grabbed it just in time. Well, we formed a friendship there, see. And, later on, I wanted to get into show business and this lady was in show business, see, so we fell in love. As you'd call it, at least,…

So, anyhow, that summer she went to my school, and I was droppin' out of school regular, now. And so far, I was droppin' out of school, but my parents didn't know it because I was leavin' the house with my lunch. And they didn't know I was dropping out, but I was droppin' out, see. And so, that summer, I went with her to Atlantic City. Because that year, my father didn't go to Atlantic City. I went with her to Atlantic City.
